scope: Adjusted only the existing procedural red-brick material after the R14 reviewer still found mortar lines too bright. No mesh, placement, roof, floor, door, fixture, or stair geometry changed.
review_finding_addressed: Reduced mortar brightness and width and decreased grayscale noise mixed into brick color. Existing brick courses are left visible but less contrasty.

source_basis.supports: Qualitative red/brown brick and visible joints at the entrance; the photo is a single perspective and not color-calibrated.
Qualitative entrance-wall brick bond and contrast only.

material.name: KNOY_Purdue_Red_Brick
material.limits: All shader values remain visual estimates. Photos do not establish exact brick/mortar reflectance, dimensions, bond, or all-face material assignments.

remaining_uncertainties: No measured/current facade elevation or calibrated all-sided photo was found; repeated facade cadence and exact material distribution remain unverified.
Publicly accessible interior material confirms lower/upper basement zones and a first-floor elevator vicinity, but not their geometry or continuous circulation.
